in_english.name: Zeeha
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zeeha originates from Arabic roots, meaning beauty, goodness, and loveliness. It is derived from the Arabic word 'زياء' (ziyā') which signifies splendor and beauty. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the concept of beauty and adornment is discussed in various verses, emphasizing the importance of inner and outer beauty for believers. Historically, the name Zeeha has been used in Islamic cultures to signify good character and physical beauty. It symbolizes the aspiration for spiritual and moral excellence.
